relations: From the reclined peak, the seat and child pivot toward an upright forward lean as the arc reverses and the legs lower.
The two chains carry the child through a continuing left-right pendulum arc across the scene.
The empty second swing hangs nearly still, its chains staying close to vertical beside the moving one.
Long shadows from the posts and chains stretch and shift across the green turf as the swing travels.
caption: The video captures a sunny outdoor playground with artificial green turf, maroon support posts, and a play structure with a cream slide under a blue sky. A young child in a dark long-sleeve shirt, olive pants, and sneakers sits in a teal bucket-style swing, gripping the two metal chains with both hands. The child and seat already trace a pendulum-like arc, the chains tilting toward the right while the body reclines and the legs lift forward. As the swing reverses, the child straightens into a more upright, forward-leaning posture with the legs tucking and the feet dangling lower, the face turning toward the camera. The motion continues back and forth, the seat arcing left and right across the scene, while long shadows stretch across the turf and an empty second swing hangs nearly still to the right.
